abstract: We establish an exact prefix–tail operator decomposition and Binet–Bernoulli tail algebra for finite-dimensional Nyman–Beurling–Báez-Duarte (NBBD) subspaces $V_N$ in $L^2((1, \infty), x^{-2}\,dx)$. Building on earlier first-octave hyperplane duality and the $15/\pi^2$ dual-norm limit, we prove via Meissel's identity that the dual representer $F_N^*(d)$ satisfies an exact floor-fiber identity, express the global inner product in first-octave cell coordinates, and derive a closed-form Sherman–Morrison formula for the first-octave bridge minimum. On higher prefix windows $N < n \le M$, the prolongation operator splits into a rank-one pole mode minus a bounded fractional-part operator; tangent deflation yields $O(M\log M)$ matrix-free two-sided rational primal-dual certificates for $d_{N, M}^2$ up to $N = 320$. On the infinite tail $n > M$, we prove that the Binet–Bernoulli waves of the Hardy–Parseval wavelets $\Upsilon_k(n)$ form a closed primitive-frequency cyclic convolution algebra where sawtooth terms cancel and odd degrees collapse to single even splines, yielding explicit Montgomery–Vaughan Farey large sieve bounds on the tail Gram matrix. These results do not resolve the Riemann Hypothesis.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Corrected the definition of the Báez-Duarte step-function generator in Eq. (1) from the typographical `{x/m} - 1/m` to the step-function generator `rho_m(x) := floor(x/m) - floor(x)/m == {x}/m - {x/m}` (`m >= 2`, `x >= 1`), and aligned the sign in Eqs. (2) and (13): since `rho_1(x) == 0` and `sum_{d | k} mu(k/d) = 0` (`k >= 2`), `tau_k(x) := sum_{d | k, d >= 2} d mu(k/d) rho_d(x) == +sum_{d | k} d mu(k/d) floor(x/d)` (so `rho_m(1) = -1/m != 0` and `tau_k(1) = mu(k)`, e.g. `tau_2(1) = -1` from both expressions), and for `g(x) = sum_{m=2}^N xi_m rho_m(x)` with `xi_1 := -sum_{m=2}^N xi_m/m`, `g(n) == +sum_{m=1}^N xi_m floor(n/m)` (`g(1) = xi_1`, so `r_1 = 1 - g(1) = 1 - xi_1` varies freely over R) and `1 - g(n) == sum_{m=1}^N eta_m floor(n/m) + Phi_N^{Mert}(n)` (`eta_m := mu(m) - xi_m`). Also wrote the normalized unit-norm mother wavelet `delta_m^{(1)}(x) := 1_{[m, infty)}(x) - (m-1) 1_{[m-1, m)}(x)` in Eq. (32), added Corollary 1 proving the unconditional `O((log N)^{-2})` tail bound for `M >= N^{3/2}` in the Ward-Ramanujan/BCF class, and added 1,800 exact `Fraction` assertions verifying Eqs. (1)-(2) and (12)-(18) to `src/verify_meissel_primal_dual_certificates.py`.
title: Meissel–Báez-Duarte Floor Duality, Raabe–Möbius Binet–Bernoulli Convolution Algebras, and Farey–Nyquist Tail Large Sieve Bounds in Nyman–Beurling Space
